title: Sibilant exercises
description: Exercises for the brightness of /s/ and /ʃ/ ("sh"), shown after the sustained hisses under Practice > Sibilants, in file order. Read from the hiss's spectral centre, scored on the resonance scale and bands.

id.description: Stable id starting with sb-. Practice history refers to it, so never change or reuse one that has shipped.

cue.description: Short name on the exercise card.

sub.description: A few words under the name on the card.

kind.description: glide: slide between /s/ and /ʃ/ twice; the /ʃ/ end of each slide is scored. ladder: one held hiss per rung, in order (reversed for a masculine goal); done when every rung is held. pairs: say words or phrases with both hisses; every hiss is sorted into /s/ or /ʃ/ and scored. Each kind has its own check in src/dsp.js, so a new kind is a code change.

sib.description: ladder only: the hiss the rungs are scored as.

name.description: One or two words shown on the rung.

say.description: The shape to hold on this rung.

rungs.description: ladder only: the rungs from darkest to brightest. A masculine goal goes through them the other way.

say.description: pairs only: the words or phrases to say.

why.description: One or two sentences on what the exercise is for.

oneOf.description: A step that depends on the training goal.

steps.description: Steps shown in order. Use an object with feminine and masculine for a step that differs by goal.
